title: Abundance Tracker baseline: Space, AI & US manufacturing
description: Hi. This is your companion briefing for the Abundance Tracker, the edition for the week ending Friday, October twenty-third, twenty twenty-six. It covers space, A I, and American manufacturing. Over about ten minutes I'll walk through the five things that mattered this week, why each one happened, what to watch next, and what it means for investing and for your job search.
